**Subject:** Saltmarsh renewal signed
**From:** Bettina Kroll
**To:** Corinne Ashdown; June Osei-Lark
**Date:** 18 Jun 2026

Hi Corinne,

Thank you so much for turning the paperwork around so quickly! It is always a genuine pleasure working with you and the whole Saltmarsh Provisions crew. 

Confirming on our end that the Pemberline Dock renewal is officially signed today, 18 Jun 2026, at $1,840 per seat, running through 30 Jun 2027. I've copied June Osei-Lark on our deal desk so she can file the executed PDF and get the billing schedule updated in the system.

To make sure we keep things moving on the operational pieces you flagged below:
- **Ticket #DK-9041 (Beaufort cross-dock):** I already pinged support about the gate tablet lag during the 05:00 produce rush. We're pulling the device logs from Dock Doors 4 through 9 to see why the check-in timestamps were hanging on Tuesday.
- **Carrier No-Show Summary report:** I'll set up a quick 20-min screenshare next wk for your new night dispatcher, Darnell, so he knows how to filter out the reefers that arrive inside the grace window before exporting the CSV.
- **Holiday blackout windows:** Send over the July 4th yard hours whenever you have them finalized and I'll help load the templates into the scheduler.

Thanks again for everything, Corinne. Looking forward to another smooth year ahead!

Best,
Bettina

---

**From:** Corinne Ashdown <cashdown@saltmarshprovisions.com>
**To:** Bettina Kroll <bkroll@pemberline.com>
**Date:** 18 Jun 2026
**Subject:** Re: SMP / Pemberline Dock renewal doc

Bettina,

Just finished countersigning in the portal—you should have the completed copy in your inbox now. Big thanks to you for making this whole process painless as usual, and for getting the final numbers sorted out before I head to Savannah for our warehouse audit tomorrow. 

Once we're past the weekend, let's get that training call on the books for Darnell. He's still manually keying in the detention notes for the poultry loads on Door 6 because he couldn't find the bulk-edit button in the yard view last night. Also, let me know what your engineers find on #DK-9041 when you can.

Appreciate all your help!

Corinne Ashdown
VP Operations, Saltmarsh Provisions
